policy.alignment: Production only: envelope correlation over first25%, bounded50ms; shared by all candidates
policy.gain: One RMS gain per complete candidate, first25% only; exact production gain as sensitivity
policy.evaluation: Remaining75%, same sample coverage for all candidates; no frame crosses calibration boundary
policy.limitations: Published same-name preset bytes unchanged; original performance MIDI and exact recorded patch revision unverified
